summary: Round473 trained on 20,000 fresh hard-opponent games, passed the strict audit after one replacement match, and completed PPO. Rollouts: 520.77 s; full input-to-checkpoint: 940.75 s; peak aggregate RSS: 9.60 GiB.

rollout_stages.stage: Action selection (includes inference and baseline scoring)

timing_caveat: Action selection includes inference and opponent scoring; do not add those component times again when interpreting end-to-end latency.

opportunities.title: Reduce public opponent scoring cost
opportunities.detail: Public Counterplay scoring averaged 77.8 ms per episode; profile shared calculations and cache state-derived features before attempting simulator replacement.

opportunities.title: Batch policy inference
opportunities.detail: Historical policy-pool inference averaged 70.2 ms per episode. Benchmark GPU batches against CPU using real search/rollout batch sizes and include transfer overhead.

opportunities.title: Improve observation throughput
opportunities.detail: Observation encoding averaged 25–29 ms per episode; target repeated feature construction and state lookups.

opportunities.title: Measure evaluation worker scaling
opportunities.detail: Round472 full-match evaluation ran at 3.51–5.78 games/s on eight CPU workers. Benchmark worker counts for complete paired matches before increasing evaluation sample sizes.
